sql.if: AND (u.nickname LIKE concat('%', #{memberKeyword}, '%') OR u.phone LIKE concat('%', #{memberKeyword}, '%'))

mapper.sql: FROM pt_private_appointment a LEFT JOIN user_info u ON u.userId = a.member_id LEFT JOIN pt_coach c ON c.id = a.coach_id LEFT JOIN pt_product p ON p.id = a.product_id LEFT JOIN store_address sa ON sa.storeAddrId = a.store_id LEFT JOIN store s ON s.storeId = sa.storeId LEFT JOIN pt_member_private_benefit b ON b.id = a.benefit_id

a.id, a.appointment_no AS appointmentNo, a.order_id AS orderId, a.benefit_id AS benefitId, b.benefit_no AS benefitNo, a.member_id AS memberId, u.nickname AS memberName, u.phone AS memberMobile, a.product_id AS productId, p.product_name AS productName, a.coach_id AS coachId, c.coach_name AS coachName, a.store_id AS storeId, s.storeName AS storeName, DATE_FORMAT(a.appointment_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS appointmentDate, DATE_FORMAT(a.start_time, '%H:%i') AS startTime, DATE_FORMAT(a.end_time, '%H:%i') AS endTime, a.lesson_count AS lessonCount, a.appointment_status AS appointmentStatus, a.cancel_reason AS cancelReason, a.created_by AS createdBy, (CASE WHEN a.created_by = a.member_id THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS proxyBook, DATE_FORMAT(a.cancel_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS cancelAt, DATE_FORMAT(a.finish_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS finishAt, DATE_FORMAT(a.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN a.appointment_status = 1 THEN 1 END) AS bookedCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN a.appointment_status = 3 THEN 1 END) AS finishedCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN a.appointment_status = 2 THEN 1 END) AS cancelledCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN a.appointment_status = 4 THEN 1 END) AS noShowCount
a.deleted = 0

SELECT
WHERE a.id = #{id} AND a.deleted = 0
AND a.store_id IN (${storeIds})
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM pt_private_appointment a WHERE a.id = #{id} AND a.deleted = 0
AND a.store_id IN (${storeIds})

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM pt_coach c WHERE c.id = #{coachId} AND c.deleted = 0
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pt_coach_store_rel r WHERE r.coach_id = c.id AND r.store_id IN (${storeIds}))

SELECT c.id, c.coach_name AS coachName, c.mobile, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(s.storeName ORDER BY r.store_id) FROM pt_coach_store_rel r LEFT JOIN store_address sa ON sa.storeAddrId = r.store_id LEFT JOIN store s ON s.storeId = sa.storeId WHERE r.coach_id = c.id) AS storeNames FROM pt_coach c WHERE c.deleted = 0 AND c.status = 1 AND (CAST(c.id AS CHAR) LIKE concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.coach_name LIKE concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.mobile LIKE concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pt_coach_store_rel r WHERE r.coach_id = c.id AND r.store_id IN (${storeIds}))
ORDER BY c.sort_no DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT u.userId AS id, u.nickname, u.phone, u.nowStoreId AS storeId, s.storeName FROM user_info u LEFT JOIN store_address sa ON sa.storeAddrId = u.nowStoreId LEFT JOIN store s ON s.storeId = sa.storeId WHERE u.isDel = 0 AND (CAST(u.userId AS CHAR) LIKE concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.nickname LIKE concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.phone LIKE concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND u.nowStoreId IN (${storeIds})
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pt_coach_store_rel r WHERE r.coach_id = #{coachId} AND r.store_id = u.nowStoreId)
ORDER BY u.createdDate DESC, u.userId DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT p.id, p.product_no AS productNo, p.product_name AS productName, p.duration_minutes AS durationMinutes
, (SELECT SUM(b.remaining_lessons) FROM pt_member_private_benefit b WHERE b.member_id = #{memberId} AND b.product_id = p.id AND b.status = 1 AND (b.expire_at IS NULL OR b.expire_at > NOW()) AND b.remaining_lessons >= 1) AS remainingLessons
FROM pt_product p WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND ( NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pt_product_coach_rel pcr WHERE pcr.product_id = p.id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pt_product_coach_rel pcr WHERE pcr.product_id = p.id AND pcr.coach_id = #{coachId}) ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pt_product_store_rel psr INNER JOIN pt_coach_store_rel csr ON csr.store_id = psr.store_id AND csr.coach_id = #{coachId} INNER JOIN pt_coach_schedule sch ON sch.coach_id = csr.coach_id AND sch.store_id = csr.store_id AND sch.is_enabled = 1 WHERE psr.product_id = p.id
AND psr.store_id IN (${storeIds})
AND psr.store_id = ( SELECT u.nowStoreId FROM user_info u WHERE u.userId = #{memberId} AND u.isDel = 0 LIMIT 1 )
)
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pt_member_private_benefit b WHERE b.member_id = #{memberId} AND b.product_id = p.id AND b.status = 1 AND (b.expire_at IS NULL OR b.expire_at > NOW()) AND b.remaining_lessons >= 1 )
AND p.listing_status = 1
ORDER BY p.sort_no DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT 50
